transport.management_and_web: Existing signed native session; API/beta token refusal retained
transport.mcp: Only new restricted bearer; native/old API/model tokens rejected
strict_json: all declared keys required, nullable only where explicit
valid UTF8, no unpaired surrogates, finite exact safe integers
semantic UTF8 byte limits additionally checked; JSON Schema maxLength alone is not a byte limit
transport.wrong_methods: 405 Allow: POST (authenticate protected MCP before returning method status)

unavailable_or_stale: No partial content/metadata/results. Return fixed error with data:null; no automatic scope expansion, refetch fallback, rerun index, credential mint or model call.
new_vs_old: New v0.3 DTO/profile/route namespace. Do not widen old 1.0/0.1/0.2 HTTP/MCP endpoints or accept new credentials there. Raw owner publication/selection/evidence_ref never appears in consumer v0.3 output.
paging: No consumer search/list cursor or top20 continuation. Read-only whole-unit traversal uses explicit target_index/unit_ordinal in read under a bound view; it is not arbitrary pagination or a separate authorization capability.

read_only_unit_contract.acquisition: inspect returns at most32 fixed target catalog entries with each authorized whole-unit count. A new read-only caller selects read.selector={kind:unit,view_id,target_index,unit_ordinal:0}; it requires read only and does not run lexical search. read returns exact evidence_ref and unit_locator. evidence selector supports later exact re-read.
read_only_unit_contract.target_order: Canonical ascending tuple(domain_id,source_id,revision_id,source_sha256,representation.kind,representation.id,producer_sha256); targets[i].target is fixed for the view. Scope/module/version change invalidates the view, never changes its ordinal meaning.
read_only_unit_contract.unit_order: Within each target sort the verified private publication rows by(range.start_byte,range.end_byte,node_id,row_id), ascending, tie-complete. Every unit is one whole existing published row, no arbitrary node/range/parent selection.
read_only_unit_contract.bounds: Catalog<=32 entries; per-target and total units<=32768. Each read returns one complete<=8192UTF8-byte unit and at most32 bounded typed summaries. target_index<catalog length and unit_ordinal<that entry unit_count; otherwise400 invalid_request after current view authorization. unit_count0 explicitly means no readable lexical unit.
read_only_unit_contract.continuation: unit_locator.next_unit_ordinal is ordinal+1 if below target_unit_count, otherwise null. This is bounded deterministic traversal inside the same current view, not a search cursor or capability. Changing view/user/credential requires a new inspect and new selectors/refs.
read_only_unit_contract.no_upgrade: read mode keeps only inspect/read tools. No search/matching/scoring/model/provider query is performed to obtain a first ref. Search requests remain denied.

effective_dependency_closure.rule: After all intersections, for each selected target t require all transitive dependency footprints in the FINAL effective selected target set E, never merely the parent module. Exact domain/source/revision/SHA and any proven representation/contribution identity must match. Unknown or incomplete footprint =>409 scope_not_supported.
stages: credential mint after view subset and requested mode attenuation
MCP inspect after credential captured subset and any further source_ids
every read/search row and typed-member proof
fresh final-permit validation before response release
effective_dependency_closure.no_widening: If A requires B but E={A}, reject the entire request. Do not silently add B, consult the parent module as authority, drop required dependencies or return partial A. Dependencies A->B->C require C in E at its exact revision/SHA.
effective_dependency_closure.coverage_basis: A footprint traceable to a specific contributing Target must be covered by that exact selected complete target. A source-only footprint requires a selected complete source_revision target proving full source_utf8 coverage of that exact revision/SHA; a different derived representation or same source_id alone is insufficient. Binary/unknown cross-source contributions without such proof are refused.
effective_dependency_closure.positive: A+B is accepted only when the complete proof footprints are covered by the actual final A+B targets. An unrelated ordinary A-only source with no outside dependency remains valid.

mcp_wire.profile: Existing protocol versions2025-11-25/2025-06-18 and current Go SDKv1.8.0; no2026 protocol upgrade. This is managed bearer, not OAuth discovery.
dispatch_priority: current bearer authentication (and parent liveness) before SDK dispatch
closed owning tool arguments and operation business checks
fresh final authentication/authorization and bounded response release

rows.case: Missing/invalid/revoked/expired credential or invalid current parent authority, before dispatch OR detected at final gate
rows.jsonrpc: No result or JSON-RPC error carrier
rows.headers: WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="knowledge-access",error="invalid_token"; no-store; do not advertise nonexistent OAuth metadata

rows.case: Invalid Origin or independently forbidden transport admission for an otherwise known principal
rows.headers: no-store; no OAuth scope escalation; tool action insufficiency is handled below, not by this row

rows.case: Authentication/final authentication DB unavailable; validity cannot be established
Body>32768 bytes / unsupported content-type / invalid Accept or protocol header / malformed JSON,batch,invalid RPC outer request
rows.jsonrpc: No tool result. Preserve current selected SDK transport rejection; use fixed bounded diagnostic/no echoed body.
rows.body: Fixed transport diagnostic only; no business data,structuredContent or text result

rows.case: Well-formed tools/call to unknown or unavailable tool, including search under read-only registry
rows.body: Official SDK invalid-params error with safe generic message; no structuredContent/text business carrier

rows.case: Known RPC method but malformed CallToolParams at SDK protocol decoding
rows.body: Official protocol invalid-params error; no operation data

rows.case: Unsupported RPC method under the selected2025 legacy HTTP transport
rows.jsonrpc: Current GoSDK checkRequest rejects before dispatch; do not claim every such request returns JSON-RPC -32601
rows.body: Fixed bounded transport diagnostic. This differs from the SDK2026 HTTP404/MethodNotFound branch, which is not selected here.

rows.case: Known registered tool: arguments fail the application closed DTO or semantic validation
rows.body: Matching operation Error envelope code=invalid_request,data:null in structuredContent and one JSON text carrier

rows.case: Known registered tool: live credential but read-only view used for search / inaccessible item / own expired view / dependency not closed / stale publication / business data DB error
rows.body: Matching operation Error envelope action_denied/not_found/view_stale/scope_not_supported/index_stale/unavailable,data:null; never mirror the native HTTP403/404/409/503 into this tool-result status

rows.case: Credential expires/revokes/loses authority during a tool call
rows.body: Use first row,not a success-shaped tool result. A later request also401. A view alone expiring while credential remains valid instead uses tool result view_stale above.

rows.case: Business response/complete encoded JSON-RPC result exceeds1MiB or output schema invalid
rows.jsonrpc: Replace entire planned result with a small fixed tool failure, preserving only a safe request id
rows.body: capacity_exceeded or integrity_error,data:null; both carriers match and are validated. Re-encode and remeasure the WHOLE JSON-RPC response including result wrapper,id,both carriers.

rows.case: Even fixed fallback cannot encode/fit; no response bytes emitted yet
rows.body: Empty body; do not emit a partial result or the rejected data
Matching success operation envelope in structuredContent and JSON text; both same decoded object

rows.case: Authenticated GET or DELETE for this sessionless/no-SSE endpoint
rows.body: Empty body; Allow: POST; invalid credentials still401 before method result

carrier_invariants: isError is explicitly true on every application tool failure and false on success. Protocol errors have error and no result; transport errors have no tool carrier.
Text parses to the exact same closed envelope as structuredContent, not merely a similar message. Error envelopes always data:null and no source/citation/count/ref.
Current bearer auth is checked at final output gate even when the planned business result is already an error. Its401/503 overrides all buffered results.
The native HTTP error status map remains unchanged for native endpoints. MCP business tool results do not reuse native HTTP statuses.
No source/SQL/secret values or rejected request body may be used as protocol diagnostics. Whole-response byte guard includes JSON-RPC id; if it cannot safely be echoed use the empty503 fallback.

native_command_receipt: Use persistence.transactions.command_receipts for all seven writes. An exact completed replay returns the ORIGINAL safe receipt data,not a current-resource snapshot; reload through the existing authorized metadata operation before a subsequent CAS edit. Credential replay never returns a secret. Known rolled-back/prevalidation failures do not consume a key; an unknown commit does not count as rollback.
